system_note: Billed line: revenue code 0192, 7 units, billed dates 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-24. Facility daily documentation does not contain any explicit per-diem-level statements for any date in the billed range (get_per_diem_level_notes returned null for each date), and the facility's daily skilled-nursing coding indicates those dates were documented at the lower nursing-only per-diem (0191) rather than at the billed 0192 level. Therapy daily-session logs show PT and OT minutes on many dates in the range, but the facility-level daily notes were coded as supporting 0191 for the stay (zero days documented at 0192 within this range). Per the audit rules, when the facility documentation itself codes the dates at 0191 and no per-diem-level statement supports 0192, the billed 0192 days must be downcoded. Correction: all 7 billed units at 0192 (2026-04-15 to 2026-04-24) are not supported at 0192 and are being changed to 0191 for those dates, reducing the 0192 line to 0 supported units and moving 7 units to 0191. Evidence relied on: daily per-diem determination tool returned no level determination statements for 2026-04-15 through 2026-04-24; facility daily skilled-nursing notes indicate the days are documented at 0191 (nursing level) rather than 0192 (the billed higher level). Reviewed revenue line: billed revenue code 0191 (skilled nursing), 2 units, DOS range 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-24 (revenue line 2). Policy reference: revenue code 0191 is the Skilled Nursing per-diem (see RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx-b8) and the reference guide defines skilled need as "A service that requires the involvement of licensed nursing or therapy staff, and could not be safely or effectively provided by non-skilled caregivers." (see RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx-b6). The same guide also notes that an individual Non-covered day is a day where documentation does not support the billed level, and such a finding applies only to specific days (see RULE-Policy-Documents-SNF-Reference-Materials-SNF-Level-of-Care-Definitions-and-Reference-Guide.docx-b11). Clinical documentation summary: the claim's daily services report documents regular occupational therapy (45 minutes) and physical therapy (60 minutes) sessions on each date within the billed range (combined therapy minutes ≈105 minutes/day on the listed dates). The facility did not supply per-day level-determination exception statements (get_per_diem_level_notes returned null for each date), which the reference guide explains commonly means the billed level's own criteria were met and no exception/downgrade was recorded. Taken together, presence of licensed therapy services meeting substantial daily minutes supports a skilled need per the reference guide definition above. No documentation was retrieved that contradicts the billed skilled nursing per-diem for these two days, and there are no facility-level statements downgrading any date within the range. Therefore the documentation supports the billed 0191 per-diem level for the full billed date range and no downcoding or unit adjustment is required for this revenue line. Citations: policy definitions and guidance cited (pol_001-pol_003). The facility daily services table was reviewed (PT 60 min + OT 45 min on each date in the range) and get_per_diem_level_notes returned null on each date (no per-day downgrade statements).
rationale_letter: Re: Audit Determination - Claim MR_SNF_04, Revenue Code 0192 (7 days, 04/15/2026-04/24/2026) Dear Provider, We completed a targeted review of the above-referenced SNF per-diem line. The claim billed seven (7) days under revenue code 0192 for dates of service 04/15/2026 through 04/24/2026. Our review of the medical record documentation shows that the facility's daily skilled-nursing notes do not record any per-diem-level determination supporting 0192 for those dates and that the facility-documented daily coding for the stay reflects these days as supported at the lower nursing-only per-diem level (0191). Although therapy session notes document PT/OT minutes on multiple dates, the facility's own per-diem level documentation is the controlling source for level assignment when present and, here, it does not support 0192. Finding: The documentation does not support the billed per-diem level 0192 for the seven (7) billed days. Basis: absence of any facility per-diem-level statement supporting 0192 for 04/15/2026-04/24/2026, and the facility's daily notes indicate the days were documented at 0191 (nursing level). Correction: The seven (7) days billed to revenue code 0192 will be downcoded to revenue code 0191 for 04/15/2026-04/24/2026. Please provide any additional documentation you believe supports 0192 for these dates if you wish to appeal. Sincerely, Clinical Audit Team
